test_title: PYST 13: SSC CGL 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 03 Dec 2022 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which figure should replace the question mark (?) if the series were to be continued?​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/db2118a64c8dfe0accee6a08ddd9ad15fb4f2fa02e1ccf72a02e24723cfc7323.png]
solution:
The figure that will replace the question mark (?) in the following figure series is shown below:

1) For 'I' element : Shifting alternately to right up corner and then left up corner subsequently.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b4c0961637ebfd0d31d94ba0edc2b0a147628c683e4cc9dd8b378794b0d26e5f.png] 

2) For 'Z' element : Replacing by C and 8, and Shifting alternately to right up corner and then left up corner subsequently.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8416b9dbf80f97af5bbf5536d7004af66a75f5a1e25a34ee8e46d1a917136d44.png] 

3) For 'B' and 'K' element : B replaced by 'T' element and K replaced by 'S' element, then interchanged alternatively in anticlockwise direction.

4) **Last three terms** are getting interchanged alternatively in clockwise direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b87a8eb67aef1bbf1eccbfdff2d56b12f5fad465335aca5409326f45c9645699.png] 

Final series is :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9018395b12f2f0c4159fca669a961e68cc754e4efc05744383745611c9006bb2.png] 

Hence, ‘Option 1’ is the correct answer.
